{{Quote|You think you know the mind of an Imperial better than I do? I spend three months in their cells. How about you?|Katcho|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Katcho''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point during his service he spend three months as an Imperial prisoners, but were eventually able to return to service. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and led a joint assault on the main base of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] - the [[Chilling Death Spire]] together with Imperial sergeant [[Ennlicher]]. Katcho refused to trust the Imperial to uphold the temporary truce they had, but was proven wrong when after death of Master [[Sav]] the Imperials showed no sign of intending to betray the Republic.
